svg.title: SysWarden HIDS, HIPS and WAAP out-of-band architecture
svg.desc: Live requests go directly to protected APIs, websites, applications and services. SysWarden observes access, security and host telemetry out of band, analyzes HIDS and WAAP signals, then applies HIPS enforcement through nftables on Linux or PF on FreeBSD. Operators use the privileged CLI, local TUI or network-facing Web TUI. TLS 1.3, bearer-authenticated HA peers and the gated BunkerWeb partner API exchange ban, unban, TTL and provenance data.

g.text: Observe host and application signals, decide locally, enforce at the host edge
SYSWARDEN IS NOT AN INLINE PROXY
Access, reverse proxy and WAAP events
Local rules, outside the HTTP pipeline
Validated before mutation, verified after commit
Ban, unban, TTL and source provenance
BunkerWeb partner API, gate off by default
SysWarden contract only, external partner proof
